title: POTV Gordito Mini Glass Bubbler
description:
The ultimate on-the-go bubbler

Get closer to at-home bubbler sessions with the POTV Gordito Mini bubbler glass! This beefy bubbler has more percolator holes and a larger water tank for bigger, cooler hits! We designed this bubbler to maximize big hitters like the Lobo and Mighty+ dry herb vaporizers so you can take those lung-busting hits anywhere!

Cooler vapor with greater airflow

Bigger is better with the Gordito. With more percolator holes and more room for water, this strapping little glass bubbler was built to handle those seeking longer, fuller draws from their POTV Lobo, Mighty+, or any other compatible vaporizer.

Still portable and spill-resistant

Take your bubbly sessions anywhere with the Gordito’s portable design. As the perfect travel companion, the Gordito is small enough to take on any excursion and quickly connects to your vape when ready.

Colors to choose from

Customize your vaping experience with a choice of 2 colors:

Available in Clear & Green

Compatibility

The Gordito is compatible with the following:

- Planet of the Vapes Lobo

- Planet of the Vapes ONE

- POTV XMAX V3 Pro

- POTV Glass Adapter for V3 Pro

- PAX Glass Adapter

- Mighty+ Glass Adapter

- Crafty+ Glass Adapter

- Volcano Glass Adapter

How to fill the POTV Gordito

The perfect water level is around a third to halfway up the bubbler, above the percolator holes. Pull a bit of water into the bubbler and let it travel all the way through until it settles. Repeat until the water sits around a third to half full.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.

Dimension

Height: 2 and 1/2 inches (64mm)
Diameter: 1 and 1/4 inches (32mm)
